Rule detects mountd mount requests over TCP, which enumerate NFS exports; this is network service discovery targeting NFS.
Same as previous but over UDP; mountd requests reveal NFS service information, constituting network service discovery.

UDP variant of AMD pid request; same service discovery behavior.

UDP variant of AMD version request; same discovery intent.
sadmind PING packets check for the presence of the distributed system administration daemon, a service discovery action.
